answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32130 Country: India Title: If I do wudhu any time(that is not the time of praying fardh namaz). Question: If I do wudhu any time(that is not the time of praying fardh namaz). Can I offer tayyitulwudhu(2 rakah after wudhu) any time? Any other advice is heartly welcome. Answer ID: 32130 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 896/896/M=1432) You can offer if it is not makrooh time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
